summary.text: In a 2024 reported statement, Mangala Kuppa described AI as transformative and said realizing its value requires embedding it in workflows while maintaining human oversight of AI output. A DOL AI compliance plan document attributed to Kuppa says DOL is drafting updated AI procurement contract language under OMB M-25-22 and intends to integrate responsible AI language into all IT contracts and interagency agreements. The same document describes a process requiring new AI tools to pass CAIO office security review before authorization, with requests evaluated against security and data-protection standards. It also states that the CAIO office reviews use cases and collects evidence on risk-management adherence, uses third-party audits when the CAIO office develops a use case, and can direct discontinuation of uses where compliance is unattainable.

A DOL AI compliance plan document attributed to Kuppa says DOL is drafting updated AI procurement contract language under OMB M-25-22 and intends to integrate responsible AI language into all IT contracts and interagency agreements.
The same document describes a process requiring new AI tools to pass CAIO office security review before authorization, with requests evaluated against security and data-protection standards.

It also states that the CAIO office reviews use cases and collects evidence on risk-management adherence, uses third-party audits when the CAIO office develops a use case, and can direct discontinuation of uses where compliance is unattainable.
